chapter: Buck and Bubbles: Nazarro and Bubbles
title: Moving up to Bubbles' Harlem apartment after two years
summary: Nazarro lets them go to Harlem after two years, where they live with John Bubbles' family.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Well, let's go on and talk -- go back to the days when you first met Buck and Bubbles. That was back in -- when you were at the Billy Pierce and Buddy Bradley Studio.
Yes, that was 1932, around February the 2nd.
Now, from the way you described it, Buck came in with Nat Nazarra, and they saw Chuck and Chuckles, and they liked the routine. Then Nazarra took you in for two years, started training you.
He was basically training you in showmanship.
After those two years, what happened?
Well, he let us go up to Harlem, and we stayed in Mr. Bubbles' apartment with his family. And he started to training us, and --
So John Bubbles lived up in Harlem?
Yes, he had his mother and a couple of sisters, you know, like that and a niece.
Up to that point Nazarra didn't allow you to go up to Harlem to see what was happening up there?
So you didn't really have the influence of all the other things that were happening up in Harlem up to that point?
Then you go up to Harlem. And what was your first reaction of going up there? What was your feeling about the place? Well, describe what Harlem was like in those days.
